google_services.gate_2_trial_input: MindTheGapps Android 10 ARM in recovery before first system boot
google_services.reason: The owner rejected further microG/login troubleshooting. This is a clean GMS experiment, not validated architecture or a claim of smallest available package.
google_services.fit_status: Offline SAR and raw space verified: 860860416 free bytes, 229316782 payload bytes plus 10485760 buffer. Actual recovery installation/boot remains untested.
google_services.fallback: Do not repeat the abandoned microG repair. Classify a delivery, account or runtime failure before selecting another experiment; failed Play delivery alone does not invalidate every YouTube Music route.
google_services.signature_status: JAR and Android whole-file detached CMS signature verified against pinned publisher certificate; actual signer SHA256/RSA with absent signed attributes. Independent publisher identity and recovery acceptance are separate.

blocking_gaps: published device.mk imports on5ltetmo vendor rather than the tablet vendor tree
selected lineage-gteslte_defconfig was not found in the public kernel tree
no reproducible build or device boot evidence
source_route.new_evidence: All136 tablet vendor-copy paths exist; import, namespace and metadata corrections remain. Preserved kernel did not yield exact config using pinned upstream extractor; complete dependencies still unpinned.
source_route.next_probe: Resolve source dependencies and defensible kernel-config provenance without whole-tree build or flash. Permitted before music succeeds; no guaranteed source-build gain.

hard_gates: Gate 0: after owner reports charge above 30%, re-read actual level/health/temperature and confirm stable external power before recovery/firmware writes. The former 80% preference is superseded. Preserve restore evidence proportionate to accepted brick risk.

Reconfirm the exact device identity, root/write access, RECOVERY by-name mapping/capacity and backup hashes before a recovery-only write. Read back written recovery bytes before reboot. Samsung Download Mode is a fallback transport, not a required detour when rooted ADB works.
Verify both downloaded release SHA-256 values and record the release archive's own updater device assertions before flash.
Boot three times; require panel, touch, Wi-Fi association and DHCP after each boot.
Record Play Protect certification state as a service-risk observation; it is not a substitute for native YouTube Music proof.
For the first reference trial, use official Play delivery and require60minutes of YouTube Music search and audible Wi-Fi playback, then reboot and repeat.
Only then qualify the browser dashboard: launch, render its required page, return to YouTube Music, and resume playback.
Require eight hours of uninterrupted audible YouTube Music Wi-Fi streaming.
Require 24 hours of screen-off powered idle, followed by a ten-minute audible YouTube Music stream.
Require tablet-only Wi-Fi interruption during playback, restore connectivity, and require association plus resumed stream within five minutes. Do not disrupt the household AP.
stop_rules: No dashboard customization or other cosmetic work begins before official YouTube Music proves sign-in and playback.

A failed GApps install, account failure, audio failure, Wi-Fi regression, or unrecoverable boot failure ends the current candidate experiment and preserves logs plus restore evidence; it does not end the appliance project.
A native runtime defect or concrete resource/control/maintenance benefit may open a bounded source/kernel packet; it does not require a prior music pass.
Android11 or newer remains an unproven port option until its exact-device build and runtime have been tested; RAM alone does not rule it out.

recovery_policy.mount_strategy: Verify exact SYSTEM by-name mapping to mmcblk0p20, 6144000 sectors and recovery fstab; reject existing mount; mount ext4 rw at private /mnt/forgeos-system; preserve uid/gid/mode/SELinux label during atomic property replacement; sync and unmount.

charge_handoff: Owner is charging tablet and will report when above 30%; no background tablet action is running.
